label: MC模拟器采集
info:
连接 PLC，从若依后端拉取设备/点位配置，动态读取寄存器并上报。

v3: C1-triggerKind自动回退 C2-防死循环 H1-重登互斥锁 H2-onceDelay/采集周期 H3-命名空间 L2-首次采集触发; v4: fn-init区分三种调用路径防刷新破坏 凭据/APIKey可配(mcSim_backendUser/Pass/apiKey) 日志守卫 质量位修正

NR4兼容: 登录用http request节点；动态请求用global.get('http')；os模块需在settings.js暴露
初始化链路: 自动IP→登录→拉点位→拉设备详情→反查node_id→MQTT→触发首次采集
依赖: node-red-contrib-mcprotocol

name: ===== 3. 采集(1s, 对齐scanIntervalMs) =====
info: TriggerKind说明: 0=握手(外部MQTT触发) 1=固定周期 2=变化触发。模拟器默认按1处理，triggerKind=0时自动回退为1并warn

willPayload: {"alert_type":"NODE_OFFLINE","node_id":999,"host_pc_ip":"127.0.0.1","msg":"[LWT] Node-RED 采集节点异常断开"}

name: 心跳MQTT+HTTP
func: const http=global.get('http');const HOST=global.get('mcSim_backendHost')||'127.0.0.1';const PORT=global.get('mcSim_backendPort')||9099;const nodeId=global.get('mcSim_nodeId')||999;const hostPcIp=global.get('mcSim_hostPcIp')||'127.0.0.1';const devId=global.get('mcSim_deviceId')||1;const jwt=global.get('mcSim_jwtToken')||'';const DEBUG=global.get('mcSim_debug')||false;const now=new Date().toLocaleString('sv-SE').replace(' ','T');let mem=0;try{mem=Math.round(process.memoryUsage().heapUsed/1024/1024)}catch(e){}const mqttMsg={topic:`edgelink/heartbeat/${nodeId}`,payload:JSON.stringify({node_id:nodeId,host_pc_ip:hostPcIp,device_id:devId,node_ip:hostPcIp,running_flows:5,memory_usage_mb:mem,status:'online',ts:now}),qos:1,retain:false};const params=`host_pc_ip=${hostPcIp}&node_ip=${hostPcIp}&running_flows=5&memory_usage_mb=${mem}`;const opts={hostname:HOST,port:PORT,path:`/monitor/heartbeat?${params}`,method:'POST',headers:{'X-API-Key':(global.get('mcSim_apiKey')||''),'Authorization':'Bearer '+jwt,'Content-Type':'application/json'}};let reauth=false;const req=http.request(opts,(res)=>{let b='';res.on('data',d=>b+=d);res.on('end',()=>{if(res.statusCode===401){if(!global.get('mcSim_reauthInProgress')){node.warn('[HB] JWT expired, trigger re-login');global.set('mcSim_jwtToken','');global.set('mcSim_configReady',false);global.set('mcSim_reauthInProgress',true);reauth=true;}}node.status({fill:res.statusCode===200?'green':'red',shape:'dot',text:'HB '+res.statusCode});});});req.setTimeout(5000,()=>{req.destroy()});req.on('error',e=>{if(DEBUG)node.warn(`[HB] err: ${e.message}`);});req.write('{}');req.end();if(reauth){return[mqttMsg,{payload:'reauth'}];}return[mqttMsg,null];
